module: Example/prototype of an HTTP remote control: on load, starts a small HTTP server (utils/simpleHttpServer) on 0.0.0.0:8081 that serves the files in /lua/ge/extensions/remoteControl/ and a few API routes, and registers a virtual input device "httpcontrollerv1" (1 axis, 2 buttons declared) with the virtual input manager. It serves as a basis for controlling the game from a phone or a browser.
notes: HTTP routes: GET /hello/<number> returns "hello world: <number>"; /api/getInfo/ returns the version, architecture, ip and port; /api/ping returns ["pong"]; /api/btn toggles the state of button 0 and emits a vinput event.
SECURITY: the server listens on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) without authentication.
onUpdate continuously emits a sinusoidal axis value (sin(t)+1)/2 on axis 0: it is only a demonstration, not real control.
M.onFirstUpdate is assigned to a local variable that is never defined (so nil): field with no effect.
onUpdate calls ws.update() even if the server was not created (ws nil before onExtensionLoaded); in practice onExtensionLoaded precedes onUpdate.
The variables httpListenPort and port are duplicated (8081 twice); the server uses `port`.

_unittests.desc: Unit test table (testExampleSuccess, testExampleFailure_shouldFail) for the game's test runner.

onFirstUpdate.desc: Reference to an undefined local variable: equals nil.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads: starts the HTTP server and declares the routes.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: processes HTTP requests and emits the virtual device's events (registers it on the first frame).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called on unload: unregisters the virtual device (the HTTP server is not explicitly stopped).

tests.desc: Example tests exposed by _unittests; the functions must start with "test".

context.desc: Test context with success() and fail().

testExampleFailure_shouldFail.desc: Example test that fails on purpose.
